title: Watercolor "Family Thyme" 1295 Western Lake Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands.- Located in the Camp District on Western Lake Drive- Corner lot across from a serene park - Fully-equipped gourmet kitchen with commercial-grade appliances- Wrap-around front porch and large screened-in porch- Primary suite has a private screened porch- Carriage house- 2-car garage - 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- 4 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Situated on a premium corner lot across the street from a serene pocket park, this quaint four-bedroom home in the camp district is warm and spacious with an abundance of natural light. The first floor features an open plan that is ideal for entertaining. French doors open onto both the wrap-around front porch and large screened porch adjacent to the kitchen and dining room. The gourmet kitchen features generous workspaces and commercial-grade appliances. There are 3 bedrooms on the second floor, including a large primary suite with an oversized walk-in closet. The primary bath features a large walk-in shower with shower and rain heads and a jetted tub. French doors open from the primary suite onto a private screened porch. The third-floor tower room has a wet bar with a refrigerator and offers spectacular views of Watercolor. The Florida cottage finish details feature custom cabinetry, built-in bookcases, wood wainscoting, and reclaimed heart pine flooring throughout. A 2-car carriage house garage is accessed directly from home and has fully appointed guest quarters with a private entrance on its second floor. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 10):SECOND FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (2), Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Bunk Room: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds (4), Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboCARRIAGE HOUSE- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.Please note: Effective March 15, 2014, Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 60 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home, and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.
